The '''''Dark Eclipse''''' was a [[Warlord Heavy Cruiser]] used by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it operated in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]<ref name="SWG:DS" /> and later in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] where it was spotted together with a group of Black Sun [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="SWG:C8">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the ship attacked a [[Nova Orion Industries|Nova Orion]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:EtF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=space|Escort the Freighter|Corellia system}}</ref> The Dark Eclipse was destroyed later the same year.<ref name="SWG:BSPQT5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Dark Eclipse'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Dark Eclipse'' could originally be found in the Dathomir system.<ref name="SWG:DS" /> The ship was added to the Bright Jewel system with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|Chapter 8]],"<ref name="SWG:C8" /> on [[January 15]], [[2008]],<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
